14: func area(shape, size)
  14: block
    15: switch shape
      16: case "circle"
        17: return ((Math.PI * size) * size)
      18: case "square"
        19: return (size * size)
23: class Stack []
  24: var(field) items = array[]
  26: func Stack.push(item)
    26: block
      27: expr this.items.push(item)
  30: func Stack.pop()
    30: block
      31: return this.items.pop()
  34: func Stack.size()
    34: block
      35: return this.items.length

    41: expr s.push((i * 10))

    44: var(const) v = s.pop()
